head: 0b7fab43e9302b1b3f1980655dee53b28b3a3c19
claim: the released @byokit/openclaw 0.26.1 signs in with a key in one setup detection (the app's poll after the sign-in asks the engine once) and keeps the provider's live model list on the key lane, so the model the picker offered stays listed and pickable

steps.start: The app has just signed in with a key: the engine holds the key and the provider's live catalog is registered.
steps: The app reads the member's providers after the sign-in (readiness)
The app reads the member's account list
The app checks whether the member is signed in to the key's provider
The app lists the key lane's models and picks the model the picker offered
The app signs in with the OpenRouter API key the person pasted
The app lists the route's models (the provider's live catalog) for the model picker
The app signs in again with the model the person chose
The app lists the key lane's models, so the picker keeps every model the vendor lists
The app runs one turn on the chosen model
steps.result: The reads after the sign-in cost one setup detection between them, and the key lane lists minimax/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash and the pick takes it. The add registered the provider's live list beside the chosen model: the key lane lists openrouter/auto, minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash and its free variant, and the run answers on the chosen model.

target.version: @byokit/openclaw 0.26.1 (the packed release tarball, installed into a consumer app outside the monorepo)

steps.start: A fresh consumer app with no package installed, no account and no key.
steps: the app installs the release tarball npm ships for @byokit/openclaw 0.26.1
the app signs in with a MiniMax API key and then polls: the providers, the account list and the signed-in check, three rounds
the app lists the key lane and picks the model the picker offered
the app signs in with an OpenRouter key and the model the person chose
the app lists the OpenRouter key lane and runs one turn on the chosen model
steps.result: The installed package answers the app's poll after the sign-in with one setup detection, the key lane lists minimax/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash and the pick takes it, and the OpenRouter sign-in registers the provider's live list beside the chosen model, so the lane lists openrouter/auto, minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash and its free variant and a run answers on the chosen model.

steps.start: The release tooling's own answer about the release that is being published.
steps: the release tooling reads the shipped notes of @byokit/openclaw 0.26.1
the shipped CHANGELOG section shows the three FIX lines the release carries
the release commit shows the version bump, the rolled changelog and the consumed change fragments
the step record of the drive at this head shows what an app does after a key sign-in and what it sees
steps.result: The release ships @byokit/openclaw 0.26.1 with three FIX notes: one setup detection per agent after a key sign-in, the key lane listing the provider's live catalog, and an OpenRouter key sign-in registering the provider's live list beside the chosen model.
